outcome: Rate of lower segment Caesarean Section
cohort: Women who underwent delivery at Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences, Islamabad, Pakistan, between October 1, 2016, and September 30, 2017
finding: The major contributor to the overall Caesarean Section rate was women with previous Caesarean delivery, single, cephalic, >37 weeks gestation.
mod_finding: Women with a previous caesarean scar should be assessed and offered trial of labour after caesarean section, where appropriate.
